test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 01 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No improvement required’.

I am so glad that I __ran into__ you on the way.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. No improvement required.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrasal verb "ran into" is used correctly in the sentence.
 
• "Ran into" means to meet someone unexpectedly.
 
• Thus, the original sentence does not require any improvement.

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
